correctness.rationale: The full cubical cell indexing by (orientation theta, subset A of its sinks) is checked against the primary definition, including no-isolate and independent-axes restrictions. For a fixed cell, an automorphism fixes the unique all-sink corner and permutes its axes, so the cellular trace is signed by the axis-permutation determinant. The g-stable-subset sum is det(I-P) on the sink permutation set; it vanishes for nonempty sink set and equals 1 for empty. Rational homological and chain alternating traces agree. Burnside plus rational transfer gives quotient χ. Separately, orbitwise inclusion-exclusion gives the explicit edge-orbit formula, with reversing orbits correctly excluded. Standalone generic verifier compares all three independently computed quantities for 11 graph families and all their automorphisms; finite checks are support, symbolic proof is universal.

Read published complete-graph equivariant work applies only to K_n; published general flex component/distance theorem concerns a distinct invariant; published universal equivariant Morse-complex formula concerns a different simplicial complex. value.rationale: The complete all-graph automorphism Lefschetz character and quotient Euler invariants are natural equivariant refinements of the central 2026 scalar flex-complex theorem, not numerical substitutions. The result proves positivity of every individual automorphism Lefschetz number, identifies a virtual permutation representation over every symmetry group, and supplies a computable vertex-/edge-orbit formula with a nontrivial edge-reversal obstruction. Neither scalar Euler data nor special complete-graph representations determine these invariants. This is a motivated structural identity applicable to any finite graph with nontrivial automorphisms, not an arbitrary small example.
